subject.title: feat(ledger): instrument review and apply actions

question: Should incomplete action-ledger setup, recovery, finalization, or publication fail affected production jobs, or should safe primary review/apply outcomes survive with a durable degraded-ledger recovery state?
rationale: The code can support conservative auditability, but choosing when ledger completeness outranks workflow availability is a permanent production policy decision that cannot be inferred safely from tests alone.

options.title: Preserve primary outcomes
options.body: Allow safe review/apply results to complete while recording ledger degradation durably and presenting a clear operator recovery path.

options.title: Require complete receipts
options.body: Treat incomplete immutable ledger handling as a production workflow failure and accept the resulting availability impact.

options.title: Pause the stacked rollout
options.body: Hold this PR and its dependent command and repair receipt PRs until the failure contract is settled.

recommendation.title: Preserve primary outcomes
recommendation.body: Allow safe review/apply results to complete while recording ledger degradation durably and presenting a clear operator recovery path.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged core, current integration, and sampled workflow history identify this person as the clearest owner of the ledger’s operational semantics.
